correctness.rationale: Weighted-value conservation and a one-index-per-round propagation of each surviving collision are rigorously proved; an index at or above floor(log2 N) cannot contain two units. Binary convolution has coefficient zero at most one; the explicit odd-k product family proves sharpness. Exhaustive and independent integer test implementations check 1359 vectors and 65025 factor pairs; they supplement, not replace, the proof.
